title: ADR-0028: sandbox-runtime replaces hand-written seatbelt profiles

content.summary: The fleet now confines its processes with **sandbox-runtime (srt)** instead of hand-written seatbelt profiles: each process starts default-deny and reaches only the hosts its settings name.

sections.h: srt replaces one hand-written profile per process

blocks.text: srt replaces the one `.sb` file per process that ran under `sandbox-exec`.

sections.h: A revert restores the old profiles and reaches ADR-0027 too

blocks.text: Restore the deleted `.sb` files from git and point the wrappers back at `sandbox-exec`. ADR-0027 builds on this decision, so a revert reaches it too.
